entry.question:
## Physical scenario

A gas following the \( pV \) trajectory of figure does \( 60\,\mathrm{J} \) of work per cycle.

## Question

What is \( p_{\max} \)?

## Answer choices

- A: A: 200 kPa

- B: B: 250 kPa

- C: C: 300 kPa

- D: D: 400 kPa

## Figure caption (auxiliary; use the image as primary evidence)

The image depicts a pressure-volume diagram with labeled axes. The vertical axis represents pressure, \( p \), measured in kilopascals (kPa), while the horizontal axis represents volume, \( V \), measured in cubic centimeters (cm\(^3\)).

- The vertical axis has markings for \( p_{\text{max}} \), 100, and 0.
- The horizontal axis is marked at intervals of 0, 200, 400, 600, 800 cm\(^3\).

In the plot, a triangular cycle is traced with three arrows indicating the direction of the cycle. The cycle:
- Starts at the bottom left corner and moves right,
- Moves upward to form another side of the triangle,
- Then descends diagonally back to the starting point.

The arrows indicate the progression around the cycle.
